text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was decided that Sakura Laurel would 
run in the Satsuki Sho. Feeling the fever 
pitch of the Classics firsthand, her chest 
swelled with emotion at standing on this 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Being able to run in the Satsuki Sho was 
thanks to being in good physical 
condition, but the lingering worries about 
her legs remained unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Sakura Laurel heads to the 
paddock without fear. She will gauge her 
limits and run with all her might.
